metadata.cache_condition: WARM OS page cache. No cold-cache measurement is made or claimed.

not_available_in_v0.read_amplification: not measured: every GET scans the whole file by design
not_available_in_v0.write_amplification: not measured: V0 writes each record exactly once, no rewrites

metadata.timing_notes: Only store calls are timed. Throughput = ops / sum of per-op latencies. put_load is stored as a summary (mean/min/max/percentiles) only; get_hit, get_miss and put_overwrite raw latencies are stored. Percentiles are nearest-rank. open_recovery is the first KVStore(path) after close() in the same process.
metadata.invocation_note: Three consecutive invocations of the V0 scaling benchmark on the same machine, same source, same parameters, run back to back. Scales are split across invocations only to keep each run short.
